TwoIsland_House_Text_CantTeachAnEgg.en: Hunh? There isn't a single move\nthat I can teach an EGG.
TwoIsland_House_Text_CantTeachAnEgg.fr: Quoi ? Mais je ne peux pas\napprendre une attaque à un OEUF.

TwoIsland_House_Text_HandedOverOneBigMus.en: {PLAYER} handed over one\nBIG MUSHROOM in exchange.

TwoIsland_House_Text_HandedOverTwoTinyMu.fr: {PLAYER} a remis deux\nPETITS CHAMPIGNONS en échange.

TwoIsland_House_Text_IllNeedMushroomOrTw.en: Then, I'll need a MUSHROOM or two.\nWhat are you going to give me?
TwoIsland_House_Text_IllNeedMushroomOrTw.fr: Alors il me faudra un CHAMPIGNON ou\ndeux. Que vas-tu me donner ?

TwoIsland_House_Text_NeedMushroomOrTwoTo.en: If your POKéMON need to learn a\nmove, I need a MUSHROOM or two.
TwoIsland_House_Text_NeedMushroomOrTwoTo.fr: Si tu veux que j'enseigne une\nattaque à ton POKéMON, reviens avec\lun champignon ou deux.

TwoIsland_House_Text_NoMoveICanTeachThat.en: Sorry…\pIt doesn't appear as if I have a\nmove I can teach that POKéMON.
TwoIsland_House_Text_NoMoveICanTeachThat.fr: Désolé…\pApparemment, il n'y a aucune\nattaque que je puisse apprendre à\lce POKéMON.

TwoIsland_House_Text_TeachMonMoveForMush.en:
I'm the POKéMON MOVE MANIAC.\pI know every single move that
POKéMON learn growing up.\pI'm also a mushroom maniac.\pBring me two TINYMUSHROOMS,
or one BIG MUSHROOM.\pIf you do that for me, I'll teach
a move to one POKéMON.
TwoIsland_House_Text_TeachMonMoveForMush.fr:
Je suis le DINGUE DES CAPACITÉS.\pJe connais chaque capacité que les
POKéMON peuvent apprendre.\pJ'adore aussi les champignons.\pRamène-moi deux PETITS CHAMPIS ou
un gros CHAMPI.\pSi tu fais ça, j'apprendrai une
capacité à un POKéMON.

TwoIsland_House_Text_WantMeToTeachMove.en: Sniff, sniff…\nHm! You smell of MUSHROOMS!\pDo you want me to teach a move\nto a POKéMON of yours?
TwoIsland_House_Text_WantMeToTeachMove.fr: Sniff, sniff… Hum, ça sent les\nCHAMPIS !\pTu veux que j'enseigne une capacité\nà un de tes POKéMON ?
